A1Analogue

Attenuverter

Four channels from −1 to +1

Four identical channels scale a signal continuously between inverted and unchanged. With nothing patched to the input, each channel becomes an adjustable voltage source.

  • Centre position = no signal
  • Inputs normalled to +5 V: offset from −5 to +5 V
  • Works with CV and audio
Width8 HP · 40.4 mm
